title: Book Three · Chapter 124: Dad's Hands
story:
A few weeks after Ronan's birthday, Dad comes home later than usual.

The evenings are warmer now. Mum has opened the kitchen window, and Ronan is taking peas out of their pods.

Dad washes, sits down, and reaches for a pod. He opens it slowly. Then he rests his right hand on the table.

“Sore again?” Mum asks.

“After the long jobs.”

Ronan looks up. Dad bends his fingers, then lays his hand flat.

“Both hands?”

“Mostly this one. Better in the mornings.”

He opens another pod and pushes the peas toward the bowl. Ronan watches the slow movement.

“Do you need to stop work?”

Dad looks at him.

“I need to change some of the day. I will talk to Mr Sun tomorrow.”

Mum nods. “Tell him about the long stretches at the bench.”

“I will.”

She turns back to the pan. Dad leaves his hand flat for a while. Ronan empties another pod and puts the peas in the bowl.

One rolls across the table. Dad stops it with his left hand and sends it back.

“That one wants to leave,” he says.

Ronan smiles, but he keeps looking at the other hand.

Dad notices.

“Ask your question.”

“Will Mr Sun still want you?”

Dad is quiet for a moment.

“There is more than one job in the workshop. He needs the work done well. We can talk about the order.”

“Can I do some of it?” Ronan asks.

“Which part?”

He has no answer ready. He looks at Dad's work bag. The tools inside it are familiar, but seeing them is different from using them.

Dad moves the pea bowl toward him.

“You can finish these tonight. Tomorrow, Mr Sun and I need to talk first.”

Ronan takes another pod. He opens it with both thumbs.

“I don't want you to lose the work.”

“I know.”

Dad sits quietly beside him. He does not promise that every job will stay the same.

Mum puts a clean cup near his left hand. Dad takes it and drinks. Then he asks Ronan about the afternoon lesson.

Ronan begins with the teacher's question. Dad asks another about his answer. Soon Ronan is talking with both hands, and a pea drops beside his chair.

Dad points to it. Ronan picks it up before he returns to the bowl.

Ronan nods. He knows Dad measures, checks, and talks to customers too. He usually pictures him with a tool in his hand.

Mum brings the pan to the stove. She asks Dad about a cupboard from that morning.

He describes its corner. The room has an uneven wall, so the back needs a different shape.

As he talks, he draws the corner with one finger on the table. Ronan follows the two lines.

“It won't sit flat otherwise?”

“That's right.”

Dad moves the pea bowl away from his drawing.

“The cupboard has no place for dinner.”

Mum laughs and gives him the plates. He carries them to the clear side of the table, one in each hand.

After dinner, Dad leaves his work bag by the door. He writes a short note about tomorrow's jobs and puts it inside.

Ronan takes the empty bowl to the kitchen. When he comes back, Dad has pulled his chair toward the open window. Mum sits beside him, and they continue their talk while Ronan clears the last plate.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

pod＝豆荚；sore＝酸痛的；stretch＝连续的一段时间；uneven＝不平整的。

## 理解问题

1. Dad的手什么时候较酸、什么时候较好？他准备由谁来商量工作安排？
2. 除了拿工具，正文还显示Dad有哪些实际工作本领？

## 读句子

**Then he rests his right hand on the table.**

拆开看：Then / he rests / his right hand / on the table.

随后／他让……歇着／自己的右手／放在桌面上。
